verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a single bullet point listing 'Chart of Accounts management' as a feature exposed via Xero's MCP server; there is no documentation describing account types, sub-accounts, or class/tag (tracking category) dimensions. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of account type configuration, sub-account hierarchy support, tracking category/class-tag setup, and any hands-on or independent corroboration of these customization capabilities.
